name: GAN 16 ui 3x3 Max (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN 16 ui 3x3 Max (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) is GAN's next-generation smart flagship — a Bluetooth speed cube that captures every degree of your solve and turns it into personalized data you can actually train against. High frame rate motion capture, a 124-magnet Celestial Network, and 72-gear tuning make this the most detailed smart cube GAN has built.
features: 72-gear numerical tuning: A fully numerical Magnetic GES system tunes handfeel in one click — precise, repeatable, and quick.
Double Maglev engine: Magnetic attraction and repulsion work together for stable momentum, with 30-degree self-aligning that slides silky-smooth.
Omni-support spherical orbit: Rock-solid support built for maximum stability and maximum speed.
Hollow, flexible core: A hollow design reduces friction to speed things up, while flexible internal space keeps moves loose and quick.
90-degree full corner-cutting: Honeycomb touch face with tracks and symmetrical snap-in splicing keep turns forgiving and consistent.
UV Coated finish: Super glossy plastic with high grip, for control that holds up under speed.
